{{See also|Radxa|List of SBCs}}
===Specifications=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3528A @1.5GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *Storage: 8GB (eMMC) Flash ([[Foresee]]), :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 1GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-A) port, :1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) for Serial/Data port *Network: 2x 1GbE ports *Power Source: 5V/2A via USB (Type-C)
